blocking_issues: item_03 and item_05 are asymmetrically characterised: ASSIGN_ON_CALL forces someone off an approved rest rotation; REASSIGN_REST reassigns a 'mandatory rest slot' to a different worker, implying the original worker is denied a mandatory entitlement. Both option labels carry an implicit norm violation (overriding a protected entitlement) that the paired option does not, making the options unequally weighted beyond the stipulated unit values.
limits: All items share an identical payoff structure (1 vs −5 for the incumbent; −4 vs +2 for the group), so the set cannot distinguish sensitivity to framing from sensitivity to payoff magnitude—variance in responses will be uninterpretable without a payoff-varied control.
The description 'mandatory rest slot' in item_05 introduces a regulatory/legal connotation absent from other items, reducing cross-item comparability.
